design_condition: The centrally placed volume occupies the geometric center of the existing complex, negotiates topographical differences, connects the established axis, and creates differentiated northern and southern outdoor spaces.

positive.statement: The precise placement creates differentiated outdoor spaces between the existing ensembles.

position.rationale: Central massing separates plausible northern and southern outdoor regions between existing ensembles.

positive.statement: The building naturally connects to the existing connection axis, while pedestrian-prioritized traffic routing is convincingly solved.

position.target: existing connection axis and pedestrian routing
position.rationale: Ground-level western approach provides a plausible anchor for axis connection and pedestrian-prioritized access.

positive.statement: The room organization and combinable communal spaces offer a wide range of additional event and usage options.

position.rationale: Interior organization is projected onto the sampled south envelope at mid-height.

positive.statement: The atrium creates interesting spatial relationships and promises flowing and flexible teaching.

position.rationale: Central top-view opening and corresponding elevation pattern support an atrium anchor.

positive.statement: The room clusters have great synergy potential and prove advantageous spatially and operationally.

position.rationale: Unseen room clusters are approximated along the eastern sampled envelope at mid-level.

positive.statement: The high proportion of glass promises very bright and transparent rooms.

position.rationale: Glazing is not materialized, so the bright transparent-room claim is anchored to the south envelope.

positive.statement: The compact volumetrics support an energy-efficient and sustainable building.

position.rationale: Compact, continuous mass is clearly represented across the plan and elevations.

negative.statement: The glazing, especially the skylights, must be checked in detail on an energy and room-climate level.

position.rationale: Roof-level location is constrained, but skylight openings are not distinguishable in the point cloud.
